description: Save each artboard as its own file, cropped to the artboard with its background, as PNG, JPEG, PSD, TIFF or PDF (File > Export > Artboards to Files), or all of them as one multi-page PDF (Artboards to PDF). The document is not changed

includeBackground.description: Fill with the artboard background colour (unless it is transparent). Default true

pdfName.description: singlePdf: the PDF file name. Default the document name

prefix.description: Text before each artboard name in the file names

singlePdf.description: pdf: one multi-page PDF instead of one PDF per artboard. Default false

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: export_artboards
title: Export Artboards
